counterfactual.change: Feasible but slow at 22 months; no biomarker relaxation reaches 18 months (all-comers gives 19). Comfortable enrolment would need ~85 sites at the current marker.

drivers: exclusion of other causes of esophageal eosinophilia (Crohn's, Churg-Strauss, achalasia, hypereosinophilic syndrome, celiac, parasitic infection)
esophageal stricture precluding endoscope passage or requiring recent dilation
washout/restriction on prior biologics including anti-IL-4R/dupilumab, anti-IL-5, anti-IgE, anti-TNF within 12-24 weeks
restriction/stability requirements on corticosteroids (systemic, swallowed, topical) and PPI/diet regimens
symptom/dysphagia frequency thresholds required at screening
general safety exclusions (malignancy, infections, bleeding disorders, esophageal varices, pregnancy)
eligibility.reasoning: Across EoE trials, a substantial share of biomarker-positive patients are excluded due to comorbid causes of eosinophilia, structural esophageal contraindications, and required washouts from steroids/biologics/PPIs, as seen consistently in NCT03029091, NCT02227836, NCT03191864, and NCT04322708. Given dupilumab's specific overlap with the anti-IL-4R washout exclusion in NCT04322708 and stricture/medication stability requirements common across trials, roughly half of biomarker-positive patients would be expected to pass full eligibility.

failedPrecedents.whyStopped: Inability to complete enrollment due to difficulty in finding subjects

High-level results from the MESSINA Phase III trial showed that AstraZeneca's Fasenra (benralizumab) did not meet one of the two dual-primary endpoints. Given the lack of clear benefit in this patient population, study has been terminated.

why: 159 patients (phase-3 precedent median (23 trials) floors the effect size d=0.8 estimate of 65) at 69 sites (p75 of at-scale precedents); precedent velocity 0.46 pt/site/mo across 91 completed trials, narrowed by 85% biomarker prevalence and 55% eligibility pass rate, with ~13 interventional trials competing for the same patients.
